title: I'm 41. I Wasted My Life.
hook: I turned 41 and felt like I had wasted my life. These are the six decisions I wish I could take back.
body: I relied on ADHD medication for years and came to regret it. I put money ahead of health, cut my sleep, and spent too much of my 20s chasing relationships. I also waited too long to work on my appearance and to use AI in my daily work, even though I believed it would change everything. The film is personal. I talk through what I would change and what you can still do differently.
close: Which of the six regrets hit closest to home for you?
youtube_description:
I turned 41 and felt like I had wasted my life. These are the six decisions I wish I could change, and what I would do now.

I had built a good life, but on my birthday I could not stop thinking about how much more I might have done. I spent years putting work ahead of health, cutting sleep, spending too much time chasing relationships, and waiting to use AI even though I believed in it. I also talk about my own experience with ADHD medication and why I wish I had discussed its long-term effects with my doctor sooner.
